title: Model Registry Stages, Approvals and Rollback
signature: class ModelRegistry: register(model, data_version, code_version, metrics) -> int; transition(model, version, to_stage, actor, approved_by=None) -> dict; rollback(model, actor) -> dict; production(model); stage(model, version); lineage(model, version); models_using_data(data_version); events
hints: Versions count per model: churn-model v1, v2 and fraud-model v1 are independent.
Check errors in the stated order and change nothing when one fires. A failed transition emits no event.
Promoting to Production first archives the current Production version (reason superseded), then promotes. Remember who was superseded: that's the rollback history.

Rollback targets the most recently superseded version that is still Archived. It is not just the latest archived version, which could be a rejected candidate or the bad build you're rolling back from.
